race.comment: MR SIOUX (3) is a lightly raced type who won his maiden here two back at short odds before an even effort at Mornington, finishing fourth at his first go on good ground. Back to the scene of the win and gets every chance up on speed. INVISIBLE MAGIC (2) beat an in-form horse in tougher company at Bendigo two back, good again there last time. Finds a nice race and should be very hard to hold out. THE QUIET IMMORTAL (4) has won two of his past three and is racing consistently well. With even luck from the inside gate he'll take holding out. SHADES OF STARDOM (7) can run well fresh off a jumpout win as can VICTORY TUNE (5) who is consistent but struggles to win.
